title: Tecnópata · Bomba remota y Escolta
description: Bip's bomb and guard (docs/animas/tecnopata/README.md § The design): Bip flies to a dog and sticks a Bomba remota on its chest; the bomb's red lamp flashes faster and faster as its clock runs out, and it implodes into a small black hole that warps the picture round it before it bursts. Then Escolta: Bip flies in an arc to stand in front of Gerard, a ring of cyan under him, and a dog that strikes him meets a shield and gets a bomb thrown on it. One player leads both in the fight tester. Run it with --gpu.

steps.eval: window.ui = window.gerard.battleUI; window.turn = id => document.querySelector('#battle .turn-meta')?.textContent === 'TU TURNO' && document.querySelector('.battle-dock[data-dock="1"]')?.dataset.member === id; ui.tweak(s => s.foes.forEach(f => { f.hp = f.maxHp = 400; }));

steps.caption: Bomba remota: Bip draws back, flies to the dog in an arc, presses the bomb onto its chest (a clank, nanites closing round it) and flies home
The bomb stuck on the dog: a graphite puck with a cyan band, its red lamp flashing slowly, its clock on the plate
The countdown: the flashes come faster and redder, the band turns red, it trembles and swells; then it implodes into a small black hole that bends everything round it, and bursts: ¡Estalla!
Escolta: Bip flies in an arc to stand in front of Gerard; a shield of cyan rings flares up round him
Bip stands guard in front of Gerard, between him and the dogs; a double ring of cyan turns under him and its tether crackles
The dogs' turn: a blow on Gerard meets Bip's shield, and Bip throws a bomb onto the dog that struck
Whoever struck Gerard carries a bomb now

Up close: the bomb crushes down as a small black hole opens where it was, the picture bending and twisting into it round a black horizon and a hot ring; light and sparks spiral in; then it snaps shut in a flash and bursts
